claims.text: The President of the General Assembly pays tribute to King Taufa'ahau Tupou IV, who 'passed away on Sunday, 10 September 2006'; Iran's representative adds that he passed away the previous Sunday in a hospital in New Zealand.
claims.locator: Page 1, 'Tribute to the memory of His Majesty King Taufa'ahau Tupou IV'
claims.uncertainty: Corroboration only: an intergovernmental record, not a Tongan one. It gives no time. Its 10 September is the New Zealand calendar date printed in Gazette No. 20 (to_crown_tupou_iv_death_20060911), where the death fell at 00:34 on 11 September, Tongan time.

claims.text: Tonga's representative speaks on behalf of King George Tupou V, and the United States representative conveys condolences to King George Tupou V, 'who has succeeded his father'. Tonga's representative also says Tupou IV became King in 1965 and reigned for 41 years.
claims.locator: Pages 2-3 (statements of Mr Wolff and Mrs 'Utoikamanu)
claims.uncertainty: A dated attestation of George Tupou V as King. The 1965 accession is year-level context outside the 1990 period and is not structured.
